levels.surface: إسحاق بن عبد الله بن أبي، طلحة

notes: «قرأت على مالك» is reading from a book, a transmission mode; مالك is occurrence 1 (the second word-match sits inside أنس بن مالك).
«يشك أيهما قال» is a doubt about a wording (ملوكا or مثل الملوك): left out.
Anas is the last link; the Prophet's words are relayed by him.
